title: Drum Mode (Digitone MIDI track drum sequencer)
author: morriess
description: Drum Mode turns a Digitone mk1 MIDI track into an 8-lane drum sequencer on the track's own MIDI channel. 0.8: DRUM MODE in the Mod Menu (hold a track key) toggles it for the active MIDI track; trig keys 1-8 play the 8 lane notes (GM drum map by default) on the track's channel, several at once; hold a pad and turn A to set its note, B its velocity; FUNC + a pad mutes its lane on playback; in live recording (RECORD + PLAY) each pad hit is written at the nearest step as a normal MIDI trig, lanes on one step as its chord notes. Hold TRIG and press a pad to select a lane; in GRID RECORDING the 16 trig keys toggle the selected lane on the shown page's steps, and light red where it plays. Two DRUM pages behind LFO on a MIDI track (Drum Notes, Drum Velocity): knobs A-H set the 8 lanes' notes and velocities. The screen's corner shows the 8 lanes: lit while a pad is held, blinking as the sequencer plays them, a dash when muted. Saved with the project. OS 1.44 only: it names the live-record flag, the step setters, GRID RECORDING's flag and page, the LED setter and the MIDI senders by address. Needs core-dn1 5.3 and seq-events.
